create.name: Amita Schmidt
create.bio:
Amita Schmidt is a Buddhist meditation teacher whose path began with Vipassana practice in 1984, including many three-month silent retreats. She spent six years as a resident teacher at the Insight Meditation Society in Massachusetts and has led mindfulness retreats around the United States since 1993. She also helped found Southwest Sangha, a self-retreat centre in New Mexico, and since 2003 she has studied with the non-dual teacher Adyashanti, an influence she credits alongside her Buddhist practice. Her chosen name, Amita, is a Sanskrit word for boundless.

Her teaching centres on insight, mindfulness, loving-kindness and what she calls fierce compassion, with practical tools for staying awake and open-hearted through change and strong emotion. She is also a licensed clinical social worker, and that background shapes how she talks about the mind. On her website she shares a library of free guided meditations and recorded dharma talks from her retreats, and she offers one-to-one mentoring by secure video. She is the author of a book on the life and teachings of the Indian meditation master Dipa Ma, and contributed cartoons to the collection Buddha Laughing. She lives in Hawaii.

books.title: Dipa Ma: The Life and Legacy of a Buddhist Master
books.author: Amy Schmidt
books.description: A portrait of Nani Bala Barua, the Indian meditation master known as Dipa Ma, who came to practice after great personal loss and later shaped many Western insight teachers. It traces her life and gathers her teachings and the memories of her students.

courses.title: One-on-One Mentoring
courses.description: Individual sessions with Amita as mentor and meditation teacher, held over secure video, for a few meetings or longer. Contact her by email or phone to arrange them.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of free recorded meditations without music, ranging from a short belly-breath practice she learnt from Tsoknyi Rinpoche to longer practices on equanimity, stillness, letting go and loving-kindness. Each can be streamed or downloaded.

free_resources.title: Spiritual Talks
free_resources.description: Free audio dharma talks and question-and-answer sessions recorded at her retreats and at meditation groups, on themes such as true refuge, embodying quiet, Dipa Ma's teachings and twelve-step practice alongside the dharma.
